meta.name: liger-autopatch
meta.description: Adds Liger Kernel support for a new HuggingFace Transformers model, or modifies existing monkey-patching. Generates lce_forward, monkey-patch function, tests, and README entry. Use when adding a new model to Liger Kernel, when a user asks to patch an unsupported model, when extending MODEL_TYPE_TO_APPLY_LIGER_FN, or when modifying/updating/fixing an existing monkey-patch (e.g., adding a new kernel to an already-supported model, fixing instance patching, updating a patch for upstream HF changes).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为 Transformers 模型添加 Liger Kernel 补丁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 Transformers 模型快速添加 Liger Kernel 支持
copy.tagline_en: Automatically add Liger Kernel support for Transformers models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly add Liger Kernel support to Transformers models

howto.what: 安装后，如果你要求添加或修改Liger Kernel对HuggingFace模型的支持，Claude会自动分析模型代码、生成补丁文件、运行测试，并在每个阶段请你确认。
howto.when: 当你要求为Liger Kernel添加一个新模型的支持，或者更新、修复、扩展现有的模型补丁时触发。关键词如“添加”、“更新”、“修复”等。

say.note: Claude会开始创建新模型补丁的完整流程。

say.text: 更新已有的Mistral补丁，修复一个bug
say.note: Claude会进入修改模式，分析变更并应用修复。

howto.what_en: After installation, if you ask to add or modify Liger Kernel support for a HuggingFace model, Claude will analyze the model source, generate patch files, run tests, and request your confirmation at each stage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a new model to Liger Kernel, or to update/fix/extend an existing monkey-patch. Keywords include "add", "update", "fix", etc.

say_en.text: Add Liger Kernel support for Llama
say_en.note: Claude starts the full pipeline for a new model.

say_en.text: Update the existing Mistral patch to fix a bug
say_en.note: Claude enters modify mode, analyzes changes, and applies fixes.
